# Bridge-iT × כזו אני — Parents Knowledge (IL Civic Skills)

Open-source, non-commercial agent skills by Bridge-iT (https://www.dynamicbridge.io) and "כזו אני" (https://kazoani.com) for navigating official Israeli child rights, special education committees, and public services in Hebrew.

- Author & Brands: Danya Dotan | Bridge-iT (https://www.dynamicbridge.io) | כזו אני (https://kazoani.com)
- Privacy: No personal or medical data is collected or stored.
- License: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Non-Commercial, Attribution to Bridge-iT / כזו אני required).

## Skills

- [IL Child Rights Navigator](/skills/il-child-rights-navigator/SKILL.md): Action-oriented navigation for Israeli parents dealing with special education committees (ועדת זכאות ואפיון), missing protocols, appeals, and child rights.
